en.eNote: No day on this board carries a food log, so the chart plots the 2,000 kcal reference across all seven. Active burn averaged 237 kcal/day, from 0 kcal on the in-progress Monday to 524 kcal on the Thursday deadlift.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414. No day on this board has a measured intake, so every bar uses the 2,000 kcal placeholder and the balance column is a reference, not a reading.
en.wNote: The bridge still holds the last measured day, Thursday Sep 3: 1,845 kcal in, 2,414 basal, 688 net exercise, −1,257 kcal balance.
en.i1: Three sessions, 3h 4m, 35,776 kg, 1,453 active kcal — against 39,093 kg in the seven days before. All three were lifting days — hack squat, deadlift, front squat; Wednesday, Friday, Sunday and the in-progress Monday are the days off.
en.i2: Saturday’s front squat held 80 kg for three working sets of 8, two reps per set under the 80 kg × 10 of Sep 12 and Sep 5. 18 sets, 180 reps, 10,576 kg in 59 minutes at 105 bpm average and a 146 bpm peak, 23.9 °C air high. Tuesday’s hack squat carried 180 kg × 12, Thursday’s deadlift 120 kg × 10.
en.i3: The last pool swim was Monday Sep 14: 2,225 m in 62 minutes as 10×100 + 10×50 at 2:14 per 100 m, the fastest of the last eight swims. Seven days have passed without one; the N4×4 set last ran on Sep 4 at 2:26 per 100 m.
en.i4: Last night scored 79 on 7h 32m with bedtime at 22:26, up from 56 on the last recorded night; Saturday night has no record. HRV 34 sits against a 42.2 28-day baseline, the lowest in 28 days; RHR 53 against 52.9. Five of the last seven recorded nights landed under seven hours.
en.rec: Tonnage over the last seven days is 35,776 kg against 39,093 kg in the seven before, with the 28-day chronic load at 37,472 kg a week — an ACWR of 0.95. The flag is sleep: five of the last seven recorded nights landed under seven hours — 6.5 h, 6.8 h, 6.9 h, 6.3 h and 4.7 h — a 3.9 h cumulative shortfall, with last night’s HRV of 34 against a 42.2 baseline. Next session: N4×4 swim, 2,250 m as 4 × 4 min hard on 3 min easy, work blocks at 2:26 per 100 m with HR capped at 150 bpm — the Sep 4 numbers. Bedtime is the lever: last night’s 22:26 lights-out gave 7h 32m, the only night of the seven above the 7.0 h baseline besides Sep 13; hold 22:30 tonight.

hr.eNote: Nijedan dan na ovoj ploči nema zapis hrane, pa graf kroz svih sedam crta referentnih 2.000 kcal. Aktivna potrošnja prosječno 237 kcal/dan, od 0 kcal u ponedjeljak koji je u tijeku do 524 kcal u četvrtak na mrtvom dizanju.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414. Nijedan dan na ovoj ploči nema izmjeren unos, pa svaki stupac koristi placeholder od 2.000 kcal, a stupac bilance je referenca, ne mjerenje.
hr.wNote: Most još drži zadnji izmjereni dan, četvrtak 3.9.: 1.845 kcal unosa, 2.414 bazal, 688 neto treninga, −1.257 kcal bilance.
hr.i1: Tri treninga, 3h 4m, 35.776 kg, 1.453 aktivnih kcal — naspram 39.093 kg u sedam dana prije. Sva tri bila su dani dizanja — hack čučanj, mrtvo dizanje, prednji čučanj; srijeda, petak, nedjelja i ponedjeljak koji je u tijeku su slobodni dani.
hr.i2: Subotnji prednji čučanj zadržao je 80 kg za tri radne serije po 8, dva ponavljanja po seriji manje od 80 kg × 10 od 12.9. i 5.9. 18 serija, 180 ponavljanja, 10.576 kg u 59 minuta uz prosjek 105 otkucaja i vrh od 146, uz najvišu temperaturu zraka 23,9 °C. Utorkov hack čučanj nosio je 180 kg × 12, četvrtkovo mrtvo dizanje 120 kg × 10.
hr.i3: Zadnje plivanje u bazenu bilo je u ponedjeljak 14.9.: 2.225 m u 62 minute kao 10×100 + 10×50 uz 2:14 na 100 m, najbrže od zadnjih osam plivanja. Prošlo je sedam dana bez plivanja; set N4×4 zadnji put je bio 4.9. uz 2:26 na 100 m.
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 79 uz 7h 32m i odlazak u krevet u 22:26, naspram 56 u zadnjoj zabilježenoj noći; subotnja noć nema zapisa. HRV 34 naspram 28-dnevne osnove od 42,2, najniže u 28 dana; RHR 53 naspram 52,9. Pet od zadnjih sedam zabilježenih noći bilo je kraće od sedam sati.
hr.rec: Tonaža u zadnjih sedam dana iznosi 35.776 kg naspram 39.093 kg u sedam dana prije, a 28-dnevno kronično opterećenje je 37.472 kg tjedno — ACWR 0,95. Upozorenje je san: pet od zadnjih sedam zabilježenih noći bilo je kraće od sedam sati — 6,5 h, 6,8 h, 6,9 h, 6,3 h i 4,7 h — ukupni manjak 3,9 h, uz sinoćnji HRV od 34 naspram osnove 42,2. Sljedeći trening: plivanje N4×4, 2.250 m kao 4 × 4 min jako uz 3 min lagano, radni blokovi uz 2:26 na 100 m i puls do najviše 150 otkucaja — brojke od 4.9. Poluga je odlazak na spavanje: sinoćnje gašenje svjetla u 22:26 dalo je 7h 32m, uz 13.9. jedinu od ovih sedam noći iznad osnove od 7,0 h; zadrži 22:30 i večeras.
